subject.title: feat: add model switch choices to /model

question: Should this PR require redacted live Slack Block Kit proof before the human-review pause is cleared?
rationale: The code path looks coherent, but the central stated Slack UX was not exercised in a live Slack workspace and bare `/model` behavior changes across channels.

options.title: Require Live Slack Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Slack evidence showing `/model` renders configured choices and that selecting one dispatches the existing model-switch path before merge.

options.title: Accept Current Proof Deliberately
options.body: A maintainer can accept the registry smoke, focused tests, CI, and Telegram proof if live Slack access is unavailable and the UX change is wanted.

options.title: Refresh Branch First
options.body: Require a rebase or merge refresh against current main before deciding proof sufficiency because nearby command/menu files have changed since the PR base.

recommendation.title: Require Live Slack Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Slack evidence showing `/model` renders configured choices and that selecting one dispatches the existing model-switch path before merge.
